author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
Map Name: Citadel 
Gamemode: Nebula DTM
Map Creator: EAJames11
Images: http://imgur.com/a/Eb8Vw  (Updated)
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/zhltse3kqnve1m6/AAAJJUWHz_HcCmi0S1VBNyVFa?dl=0 (Hopefully updated, please tell if doesn't work. New to this!)
YMAL: http://pastebin.com/zXL4xhkT (Updated)
Information: 
Legion (Purple) Vs. Immortals (Black) 25 vs 25
3 monuments per team. (Left, center, right) 
Iron and Diamonds
Loadout: Leather Helmet, Chestplate, and Boots. Iron Pants
Iron sword, Infinity bow, effeciency 1 Diamond Pickaxe
3 Golden apples, 32 steak, 64 glass, 64 Oak logs, 1 arrow.

PS: This is my first map and I'm hoping all goes well. Any feedback would be appreciated, thanks!
Also, if I did something wrong on the YMAL, please tell me, I've never done anything CLOSE to that.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Update 1.1: I have added some more island, although quite small, I like them. I hope to soon add a large attachment to the"Turtles" for sword fighting. The looks were improved slightly, and some YMAL errors have been fixed.

replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
Feedback.

  • A lot of void as stated above
  • Not much PVP room
  • Lanes are quite thin
  • I feel most of the PVP will be on bridges rather than on the main land of the map
  • Block palette is quite plain. I'm not sure if you were going for this but can you add a bit more colour or something that makes it more pleasing to look at
  • Whats the point of having all those miniature islands around the front lines you can get shot off them really quite easily and they really serve not much purpose
  • Reduce blocks. Block spamming might be a big issue with the map as the area of the map itself is quite small.
